title: Replace fixed R&D cadence with event-triggered research cycles
description: R&D last ran 108h ago and fires on a fixed 3-day clock. Markets don't care about our schedule. High-conviction opportunities emerge after earnings beats, sector breakouts, and macro prints — not on a Tuesday-every-three-days basis. Proposal: keep the 3-day heartbeat, but add event triggers: any sector ETF moving >3% in a day forces an immediate targeted R&D cycle for that sector only. Canary YELLOW triggers a full cycle. This would have caught the DIS move that fired ORANGE today.
evidence: last_research_run: 2026-08-14 (108h ago). Canary fired 199 alert(s) today without fresh research.
proposed_fix: In canary_agent.py: when a sector ETF moves >3% intraday, write `data/rd_trigger.json` with the sector name. In main.py Step 3c: if rd_trigger.json exists and is <4h old, run rd_team_leader.py --sector <name> regardless of 3-day cadence. Delete the trigger file after the cycle completes.
